<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex014022026-09-2202-38-16" status="unreviewed"><note type="editorial">Compare with ex023012026-09-1501-08-55</note>'grel par <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3809">khyung</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3827">'brom</rs> mi ma bcug na brgal lan gyi khyad mi 'ong pas mi 
rigs so zhes gsungs pa <lb n="108b6"/> ni 'thad do || dpe la 'jug pa'i tshad mas spangs pa'i sgo nas sgom pa'i lam shin tu ba rdo rje lta bu'o|_kha cig nas tha ma zer ro || 
de ltar klan ka spangs 
pas spang bya chen po la sogs pa gnyen po chung ngu la sogs pas spong bar 'grub bo || 
<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs> 
na re rnam par <lb n="108b7"/> dag pa ni khams gsum du skye ba ma lags so || 
chos la sems pa med pas 
rnam par mi shes so zhes pas lam ni khams gsum pa dag gi gnyen po nyid du 'dod pa 
yin || </seg></TEI>
